verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workflows is a first-party, durable workflow engine on Workers. It chains multiple steps, automatically retries failed tasks, and persists state for minutes to weeks with no infrastructure to manage. It can also pause for external events or approvals, so developers avoid hand-wiring queues and retries. Missing for 10: concrete docs showing how workflow steps are defined in code and deployed (e.g., step APIs, Wrangler deploy flow), and independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running durability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries

citations.quote: you can build applications that chain together multiple steps, automatically retry failed tasks, and persist state for minutes, hours, or even weeks - with no infrastructure to manage
The ability to pause for external events or approvals
Schedule cron jobs, run durable Workflows, and integrate with Queues
